notes.note: Re-reviewed the two-rule badge correction after hosted gallery run 37161581781: whole-button overflow clipping changed the unbound FolderGlyph raster by 13 pixels, and stretched labels inherited centered button text. Removed the redundant outer clip and explicitly left-aligned only the label column; each label still owns truncation. Existing New chats/project-default and mobile-picker claims remain accurate. The owner alignment assertion failed 8 pre-fix cases at 800/1200 in both themes/orders; corrected owner/sibling suites passed 63 tests. After a clean source commit, removing text-align reproduced 8 failures and restoration passed 40 header cases. Isolated real-CSS/Glyph projection preserved base pixels for comfortable unbound/bound/mismatch badges and retained narrow client47/scroll47 geometry. Gallery baselines remain unchanged; a new hosted full-gallery result and physical-device/full-app font evidence remain unverified.
